description: Pursuing the leather clue, the backstabbing in Milan conceals the true information, as the investigators gradually grasp the outline of the conspiracy behind the scenes.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The doorman showed no reaction to player4's words, continuing to lead them toward the elevator with a sleepwalking pace.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I think it's not just this doorman; the whole city's people are strange."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "What have they been through?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: On a sofa in the distant lobby, two noblewomen in mink coats were playing cards, but they were only tearing each card in half and neatly stacking them on a gilded side table.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #After pondering for a long time, decided to recall that truly forbidden knowledge. "Or have They influenced this world."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Are these still humans?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Kick the agent twice to see his reaction and if it's the same as these people.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Don't go all out on teammates; you're not even sparing an outsider." #Advised earnestly.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi immediately jumped up as if electrocuted: Holy Mother of God! Are you insane? His face flushed red as he rubbed his leg, anger and terror vividly alternating on his face—a stark contrast to the sleepwalking numbness of the Milan locals. He even instinctively checked if his leather shoes were damaged, such attention to material details being a luxury in Milan now.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .ra cm

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will surely be answered. <player5>'s cm wish:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st show luck

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s currently registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Forget it, I don't really have any ideas. Let's collect more information first, then make inferences."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The professor is right."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "It seems you're still normal, congratulations."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Weird."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Bailan struggled to recall those dusty forbidden knowledge, trying to link the anomalies before her to certain indescribable existences. But those memories that should have been clear now seemed behind frosted glass; the harder she tried to recall, the fuzzier the details became. She only vaguely remembered fragments about the invisible erosion of evil entities, but couldn't even recall the source.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mr. Rossi, were you on the train last night too?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Agent Rossi's cheeks trembled with anger: N-normal?! He tugged at his sweat-soaked tie, gritting his teeth. The elevator doors before you slowly opened, and an old woman in a mink coat walked out, numbly fiddling with a pearl necklace. Seeing this, Rossi suddenly deflated, loosening his grip and muttering: God... even the madhouse in our Bologna has more life than this...

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Wryly smiled. "Maybe we'll know the reason for these people's poor spirits tonight."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That would be terrible."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hey, are all you Milanese like this?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Of course... I'm Caterina's agent."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Why are they as listless as the husband of that *positive* case I treated last month?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Good heavens, it was never like this before! His voice trembled. Last year when I came to Milan, after the La Scala opera, the whole street was full of drunkards singing opera... Now you see, Rossi pulled out a handkerchief and wiped his forehead vigorously, even the pigeons fly slower than church funeral bells.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Strange, when did this start?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That is indeed very abnormal."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mr. Rossi, this might be a bit offensive, but why are you unaffected?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "But are there really any normal people here?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Isn't the normal person right in front of us?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "There's a possibility he wasn't there at the time."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi frowned: I... I just discovered it too. The last time I came was last October... back then, Mussolini had just entered Rome, the streets were full of cheering people...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Our commonality is that we haven't been here all along."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: But this isn't right, he licked his dry lips, even if political fervor has cooled down, it shouldn't be like...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "What's done is done."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hiss"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "player4, cut a piece of my skin."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Otherwise what? Run onto the road and grab a passerby?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This could easily be the delusion of a poet who got drunk hundreds of years ago."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "We've even seen that kind of terrifying rose."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Whispering conspiracy "We could totally find someone who's drunk."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "So now, do it quickly, at least we have a reliable doctor."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "It just so happens the people here are all crazy."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "This is not advisable to cut, it might not work. And there are people nearby." #Looks at Rossi beside them.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Taking a step back,"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "That makes sense too." #Glances at Cicero

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Let's find a place to stay first, I'm so tired."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Sat there daydreaming for a long time."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Should we find a room to sit and talk inside?"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "You might as well find Caterina's tenor enemy to skin, and interrogate him about her whereabouts at the same time."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Rubs chin

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: I think from what you said about the spell, skinning would definitely scare the guts out of this kid.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi spread his hands helplessly: If I knew what the hell was going on with this place, I would have taken Caterina back to Bologna long ago.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Where's Bologna?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Who told you to think about that?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The agent suddenly grabbed his increasingly sparse hair: Christ, right now I just hope the people who kidnapped her at least... at least still have the rationality to negotiate...

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I really don't know much about the geography here."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Hurry up and think about who might have kidnapped him."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi's expression instantly brightened, temporarily forgetting his fear: You really don't know? My hometown, the best place for meat sauce pasta in the world! He was so excited his bow tie went crooked, the San Luca Gallery has 666 arches, the twin towers lean so much they'd make the Leaning Tower of Pisa feel inferior... Anyway, the agent suddenly deflated, his voice dropping, it's a place where living people should be...

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I think we should wait for the kidnappers to contact us"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hmm, it seems that's really the only way."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Go hunting at night"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "After all, it feels like this city is already different from before."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "First, we should figure out how the anomaly occurred"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Is the anomaly important?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "As for Caterina, I'm sorry, we'd better pray the kidnapper is human"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "My only thought right now is to find the statue quickly and leave this damn place"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi shivered from the shout, his fingers twisting his tie almost to the point of breaking it: I, I really don't know! He cried out with a sob, his voice stirring slight echoes in the empty lobby, if the mafia kidnapped her they'd at least leave a note, if it was the Fascists... He suddenly fell silent, because two young men in black shirts walked out of the door next to you. You arrive at your respective room doors.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Pack things

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Carefully observe the room.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Continue, they're gone"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi breathed a sigh of relief, collapsing on the sofa like a deflated balloon: They didn't look this way... for now. He nervously chewed his thumbnail, honestly, I can't even remember what I ate last night... The agent forced a smile uglier than crying: Look, how about we get some sleep first? Maybe... maybe when we wake up, the world will be back to normal?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sir, I sympathize with your experience, but I think you need to calm down first"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Room 307 is an elegantly furnished ordinary suite. The walnut furniture is polished to a shine, the double bed is made with crisp ironed linen sheets. Outside the window, the sky is dark, but the outlines of the buildings opposite and the traffic on the street are clearly visible. Everything looks very normal—except for the policeman walking in circles in the square downstairs, who has been following the same route for at least twenty minutes.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "A strange place"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I recognize the importance of sleep, but if you think sleeping will solve it, you must be sleeping too much"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Exclaimed

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi took a deep breath, wiped the sweat from his forehead with a handkerchief, and tried to steady his voice: You're right... I really need to calm down. He loosened his tie, his breathing gradually becoming regular, it's just all so sudden... Caterina she... Sorry, I lost my composure. We... we need to think about what to do next. Although his fingers still trembled slightly, his tone had regained basic composure, at least no longer as incoherent as before.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "What we need to do now is stay calm, then wait for news from the kidnappers, or, trust in Lady Luck"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The investigators took Rossi to the hotel restaurant. The dining hall, which should have been bustling at lunchtime, was eerily quiet, with only a few scattered tables of guests. Waiters mechanically served the meals one by one. Rossi poked at the lasagna on his plate without tasting it. The restaurant's glass door suddenly swung open, and a young man in a black shirt stood in the doorway scanning the room. Rossi's fork clattered onto the porcelain plate, but the man just slowly turned and left.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Eat first"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "I think we should leave, that person looks like a lookout." #Watching the person's retreating back, getting up from the seat.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Mhm mhm."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The agent then snapped out of it as if waking from a dream, grabbed his fork, and quickly stuffed noodles into his mouth

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Maybe it's some kind of gang war, we might get caught up in it" #Grabbing a piece of bread, heading out of the shop

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hiss, I think it's more than just a gang war"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Who's the strong dragon?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ahem, I mean, we're on someone else's turf, it's better to keep a low profile"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Pack two portions of lasagna and take them back to the room

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: No one

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Does anyone have any plans?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Lean close to the agent's ear and ask, "Are you a communist?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi choked violently, spitting half a mouthful of coffee onto the napkin. He jerked back as if electrocuted, almost falling off his chair: Mother of God! Are you trying to get me killed? His fingers dug into the edge of the tablecloth.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Political struggles are terrifying."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I've checked, no one." #Continue whispering

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Mutter quietly, "It's completely different from what the books say."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Rossi's face turned pale, and his knife clattered to the floor: I swear! I don't even know how to sing The Internationale! He frantically made the sign of the cross. My aunt's cousin was even put on the Blackshirts' castor oil enema truck for reporting on socialists...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Then why are you so resistant to the local government?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Huh?" #Look over there in confusion

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Exactly." #Chime in agreement

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Alright, calm down, calm down. We're not so poor that we need to sell you for money."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Sir, in Milan nowadays... those who resist the government are lying at the bottom of the Tiber River. He tugged nervously at his tie. "I'm just a cowardly agent."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Now, wait for nightfall.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The investigators spent the afternoon acting separately, gathering other materials needed for the spell in the streets and alleys of Milan. As night fell, they returned to the hotel with suitcases filled with strange items. Outside the window, the spires of Milan Cathedral gradually faded into darkness. Streetlights came on, but the light seemed more dim than usual.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Turn on a flashlight to look.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Stop player2's action.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Under the flashlight beam, a man in work clothes can vaguely be seen lying down.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Take out the sealed ether from the bag.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: He... is lying in a pool of blood.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "player4, do it."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Wait."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Hold my breath and listen for nearby sounds.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Help player4 keep watch around.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Listen

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; what you hope for will surely receive a response. <player4>'s prayer for listening:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 holds their breath and focuses. In the alley, only the distant sound of dripping water and the wind remain. Further away, the faint hum of a tram passing can be heard. The area around the alley is deathly quiet, not even the footsteps of stray cats.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Seems like no one's here..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Have Bailan and Johnson protect me and player4

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Using the flashlight's light, deftly strip off this unlucky person's shirt and check if the skin on the back is intact

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 crouches down and finds the corpse's work shirt front completely torn open, revealing a pale chest. The deceased's right hand is clenched into a fist, with a corner of a work ID peeking out from between the fingers.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Look at the work ID

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: As for the back skin, it's very intact.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Check his wound while you're at it

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 gently pries open the stiff fingers of the deceased and retrieves the blood-stained work ID. By the faint light, one can see it's printed with "Neo Spinola - Alfa Romeo Automobile Factory Assembly Workshop," with a union badge sticker in the corner.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Medicine

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; what you hope for will surely receive a response. <player4>'s Medicine prayer:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The exposed lung tissue surface is covered with grayish-white nodular lesions, typical of tuberculosis foci.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This is tuberculosis."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Huh?"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Stay away." #Move farther away

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Put on a mask."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: (Had it from the start)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Still have many doubts, but this is no place to linger. Quickly skin it.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 obtains skin sufficient for the ritual.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #See if two pieces can be skinned.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Then skin*2 is obtained.
